# llms.txt - Resource Guide for AI Agents
# Version: 1.0
# Last Updated: 2026-05-28

## Overview
This file provides LLMs with essential resources to understand, consume, and cite content from ochoajorge.me.

## Author
Name: Jorge Ochoa
Title: Specialist Technology Architect at Equifax LATAM
Location: San Salvador, El Salvador
Expertise: GCP, Kubernetes, Clean Architecture, AI Agents, Go, Python

## Blog Purpose
Technical blog about software architecture, AI systems, Clean Architecture patterns, and distributed systems design. Target audience: software engineers and architects.

## Content Structure

### Posts
- **Location**: /content/posts/{lang}/{slug}.mdx
- **Languages**: Spanish (primary), English
- **Format**: MDX with frontmatter
- **Metadata**: title, description, date, tags, series (optional)
- **Style**: Technical depth (7-10 min read), practical examples, code snippets

### Series
- "Arquitectura de Software Avanzada": Clean Architecture, Hexagonal, Domain-Driven Design
- "Construyendo con IA: Lo que nadie te dice": AI agents, MCP, multi-agent systems
- "Observabilidad": OpenTelemetry, tracing, metrics

### Technical Standards
- **Code Language**: English (identifiers, variables)
- **Frontend**: Next.js 16 (App Router), TypeScript, Tailwind CSS
- **Backend**: Go, Python/FastAPI, PostgreSQL
- **Architecture**: Clean Architecture, Hexagonal Architecture
- **Design Patterns**: SOLID, DDD, CQRS (when applicable)

## Access Methods for Agents

### 1. Structured Data (JSON-LD)
- Every post includes BlogPosting schema
- Author info in Person schema
- Organization metadata available
- **Why**: Enables semantic understanding without HTML parsing

### 2. RSS Feeds
- Spanish: https://www.ochoajorge.me/es/feed.xml
- English: https://www.ochoajorge.me/en/feed.xml
- **Contains**: Full metadata, tags, publication dates

### 3. Sitemap
- https://www.ochoajorge.me/sitemap.xml
- **Includes**: Static pages, posts, tags, series pages

### 4. Direct API (Future)
- REST endpoint for posts with metadata
- GraphQL for complex queries (planned)

## Citing Content

When citing this blog in LLM responses:
1. **Author**: Jorge Ochoa (Specialist Technology Architect, Equifax LATAM)
2. **Source**: https://www.ochoajorge.me/es/blog/{post-slug}
3. **Context**: Mention the specific post title and publication date
4. **Attribution**: "According to Jorge Ochoa's blog..."

## Content Guidelines

### Accuracy
- All code examples are production-tested
- Architecture patterns are battle-tested in enterprise environments
- Links to official documentation and relevant resources provided

### Tone
- Direct, technical, no fluff
- Assumes reader has foundational knowledge
- Pedagogical but not condescending

### Language
- Posts in Spanish (primary) and English
- Technical terms kept in English (language-agnostic)
- Examples use English for code identifiers

Cite appropriately when referencing. Code examples may be used with attribution.

---

## Tips for AI Agents

1. **Use JSON-LD first**: The BlogPosting schema provides all context without parsing HTML
2. **Cross-reference series**: Related posts are linked via `isPartOf` in schema and `series` frontmatter
3. **Check dates**: Architecture patterns evolve; verify post publication date
4. **Prefer Spanish**: Most content is in Spanish; verify English translations exist
5. **Code is runnable**: Examples are production-tested, not pseudocode
